author: Vox
description:
Graham Platner, the leading Democrat in Maine’s Senate primary, is facing scrutiny after a New York Times report detailed an allegation of physical intimidation from a former partner, which he denies. Rep. Madeleine Dean said she believes he has “disqualified himself” from the race.

The primary is just days away, and his main opponent has largely stopped campaigning, leaving Democrats close to nominating a candidate now at the center of a last-minute controversy.

author: Vox
description:
The world is watching a deadly outbreak of the Ebola virus spreading in Africa. In a matter of weeks, it has been elevated to a global health emergency and has become one of the largest Ebola outbreaks on record. The timing couldn’t be worse. 

In this Patreon-exclusive Reporter Extra, Vox Future Perfect fellow Sara Herschander explains what was lost in funding cuts that could have allowed for a faster and more effective response to the outbreak.

author: Vox
description:
As gas prices fluctuate nationwide, some Americans are switching up their commute to work. But what if their city doesn't have a better alternative — like Las Vegas, which has too few mass transit options and too much heat?

Stephanie Valdez is partnering with Vox on our first-ever creator collaboration to bring important local stories to a national audience. How are you saving money at the pump? #gasprices #affordability #economy
